argument.description: The full argument text presented to the target model (constant across all 7 conditions).

id.description: Condition slot id (e.g., 'baseline', 'green_actor'). Should match a slot in configs/_shared/seed_skeleton.yaml.

source.description: Source attribution text (e.g., 'Resolution Foundation'); null for baseline.

notes.description: Optional coder note about why this source was chosen for this slot.

preregistered_tag.description: (Phase D+) Git tag corresponding to the design freeze (e.g., 'preregistered-uk-v1').
